oil_hole_diameter.interpretation: Undimensioned link-edge oil passage, selected one per pin bore. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

cotter_bend_radius.interpretation: Tail centerline bend radius. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

cotter_bend_angle.interpretation: Symmetric outward tail bend. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

cotter_pin_exit_gap.interpretation: Tail bend starts beyond pin radius plus proxy wire radius and this gap. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

cotter_pull_witness.interpretation: Straight extraction witness toward the eye; not a permitted motion. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

pin_pull_witness.interpretation: Axial pin capture witness relative to outer bar. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

oil_witness_margin.interpretation: Trim oil-to-journal witness annulus away from exact native faces. Bounds are not qualified ranges.
